name: replaceList
description:
Replaces occurrences of the elements from a delimited list
in a string with corresponding elements from another delimited
list. The search is case-sensitive.
syntax: replaceList( string string, string list1, string list2, [string delimiter_list1], [string delimiter_list2], [boolean includeEmptyFields] )

params.name: delimiter_list1
params.description: Delimiter for search, or if no replacement delimiter is defined, this delimiter is used for search and replacement.

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: When true, empty elements are preserved
